brief: The canvas simulates a fly-through view from a drone navigating a sprawling, abandoned college campus. The viewer observes the rigid, angular geometry of raw, monolithic concrete structures characteristic of brutalist design. These severe gray planes are disrupted by vibrant splashes of natural color; overgrown weeds push defiantly through the deep cracks in the walkways and foundation, softening the harsh edges of the architecture. The entire scene is defined by continuous, smooth lateral and depth movement as the drone drifts through the deserted grounds.

statement: This sketch simulates a drone fly-through of an abandoned brutalist college campus. The viewer navigates through stark concrete architecture defined by angular, monolithic forms that dominate the landscape. The scene is softened by vibrant green weeds pushing through cracks in walkways and foundations, creating a contrast between harsh geometric structures and organic growth. The continuous lateral and depth movement of the drone creates an immersive exploration experience, with the camera drifting smoothly through the deserted grounds while maintaining visual coherence between architectural elements and natural disruption.
